title: RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Red teaming must continually adapt as frontier LLM safeguards evolve, yet existing approaches largely search for adversarial prompts or optimize within fixed attack procedures. We observe that even when an attack becomes ineffective, its underlying mechanisms can remain useful and can be revised or recombined to construct stronger attacks. Based on this insight, we introduce RedDarwin, an agentic framework that shifts the unit of jailbreak evolution from prompts and fixed attacks to executable attack skills. RedDarwin consists of 47 reusable base skills and autonomously revises, composes, executes, and selects them using target-model feedback, allowing successful discoveries to become building blocks for subsequent evolution. RedDarwin produces 65 evolved skills, improving 44 of 47 base attacks and increasing their mean attack success rate (ASR) on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%. translated_title: RedDarwin：针对前沿大语言模型的越狱技能进化
translated_abstract: 随着前沿大语言模型安全防护措施的不断演进，红队测试必须持续适应，然而现有方法主要是在搜索对抗性提示词或在固定的攻击流程内进行优化。我们观察到，即使某个攻击手段变得无效，其底层机制仍然可能有用，可以通过修改或重新组合来构建更强的攻击。基于这一洞察，我们提出了 RedDarwin，一个智能体框架，它将越狱进化的单元从提示词和固定攻击转变为可执行的攻击技能。RedDarwin 由 47 个可复用的基础技能组成，并利用目标模型的反馈自主地修改、组合、执行和选择这些技能，使成功的发现成为后续进化的构建模块。RedDarwin 产出了 65 个进化技能，改进了 47 个基础攻击中的 44 个，并将其在 AdvBench 上的平均攻击成功率（ASR）从 18.8% 提升至 47.3%。这些进化技能在各项基准上持续优于基线方法。
tldr: RedDarwin 提出一个智能体框架，将越狱进化的基本单元从提示词转变为可执行的攻击技能，通过自主修改、组合与选择 47 个基础技能进化出 65 个更强技能，将平均攻击成功率从 18.8% 提升至 47.3%。
en_tdlr: RedDarwin is an agentic framework that shifts jailbreak evolution from prompts to executable attack skills, autonomously revising and recombining 47 base skills into 65 evolved skills that raise the mean attack success rate on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%.
